csv_project_name: Consultant for Regional Open Space & Recreational Trail Map
csv_agency: South Central Regional Council Government SCRCOG
csv_scope_of_work: The South Central Regional Council of Governments ( SCRCOG ) is seeking proposals from a qualified consultant with expertise in geospatial analysis, open space planning, and recreational trail inventorying to update the South Central Region s Open Space & Recreational Trails Inventory. The project builds on our Open Space Inventory, completed in 2018, and our Regional Recreational Trails Mapping Project, completed in 2016 and has been modified as needed. The project includes compiling, verifying, and enhancing geospatial data related to regional open space assets and recreational trail networks to ensure accuracy, consistency, and completeness in supporting regional planning and decision-making efforts.
csv_disciplines_requested: Interior Design/Space Planning, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Surveying/GIS/Mapping, Land Use Planning, Planning/Master Planning, Redevelopment Planning, Environmental Engineering/Planning/Design, Urban Studies/Planning/Design

title: Consultant for Regional Open Space & Recreational Trail Map
short_description: Consulting services to update regional open space and recreational trail inventory mapping.
project_scope: Update the South Central Region's Open Space and Recreational Trails Inventory, building on a 2018 open space inventory and a 2016 regional recreational trails mapping project. Scope includes compiling, verifying, and enhancing geospatial data for regional open space assets and recreational trail networks to improve accuracy, consistency, and completeness for regional planning and decision-making.
services: Consulting services for geospatial analysis, open space planning, recreational trail inventorying, GIS/mapping, land use planning, landscape architecture, civil engineering, surveying, environmental planning/design, and master planning.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily an open space, trail mapping, GIS, and regional planning assignment.
- No bridge, building, roof, stadium, or special structural engineering scope is indicated.
- Falls under pure urban/open space planning and surveying/GIS, which are explicitly low-priority or reject types for sbp.
- No structural complexity, span, load-bearing design, or planning component relevant to sbp's core expertise.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction works or construction budget are stated. The notice describes a consulting/planning and GIS inventory update only, with no physical building or infrastructure scope from which a realistic construction cost could be derived.
fee_explanation: No fee information is provided in the notice. As this is a general consulting/GIS planning assignment outside sbp's core structural scope, no reliable sbp fee estimate can be derived from the available information.
references_qualifications: Qualified consultant with expertise in geospatial analysis, open space planning, and recreational trail inventorying.
contracting_authority: South Central Regional Council of Governments (SCRCOG), North Haven, CT, USA. Contact: Brendon Dukett. Phone: 203-466-8626. Email: purchasing@scrcog.org. Website: https://scrcog.org/rfp-02703/
notes: Questions deadline: 07/02/2026 12:00 PM EDT. Solicitation documents available online. Although civil engineering is listed among requested disciplines, the actual scope is non-structural GIS/open space planning and not relevant to sbp's core services.
